title: blob_upload buffers up to 100 MiB in memory for SHA-256
description: blob_upload_handler (blob.rs:84) calls axum::body::to_bytes(body, MAX_BLOB_BYTES+1) which buffers the full request body (up to 100 MiB) in heap before any I/O. SHA-256 is then computed over the in-memory bytes. This is 100 MiB heap per concurrent upload. KITH-hqrw.18 covers the symmetric read path. Fix: stream-hash using a rolling Sha256 digest as bytes arrive, write directly to disk during streaming, then finalize the hash. Avoids the full-body allocation. Non-trivial but necessary if concurrent uploads are expected at Phase 2.
